_comment: What tools/spec_catalog.py read from the Python backend (src-python: mainloop.py, utils.py, errors.py, config.py) before it was removed in 0.6.0 (#285). The rows stay in the order Python had them; what only the Rust core has is in spec_core_additions.json. Change a row here when the core changes what the specification lists. VERSION's default is the version in package.json, which utils/update_version.py sets.
